messages:
talia: Quick personal update — signed the papers today and officially moved into a tiny house! Also got promoted to Senior Product Engineer 🎉 Tiny victory dance.

mike: WHAT?! double congrats!! housewarming + promo in one week? count me in. :partying_face:

anya: Talia!! massive congrats 🎊🎊. Office celebration poll: chocolate cake vs lemon drizzle vs nothing at all (just flowers). My vote: lemon.

lee: Congrats!!! I will happily be designated box-lifter and/or plant-waterer. Also: when are we celebrating? Friday lunchtime?

hr-bot: Congrats @talia on promotion to Senior Product Engineer — HR note: please confirm your new title & start date in People Ops by EOD so payroll/benefits reflect it. Link: https://peopleops.internal/redwood/profile

jenna: OH YAY. I volunteer to bring lasagna (vegetarian option available). Also lemon cake sounds amazing.

cleo: Lemon cake champion here. Also suggestion: a low-light houseplant (ZZ plant or snake plant) as a small housewarming from the team? 

mike: +1 on ZZ plant. Also I can bring some bubbly if people want to toast.

talia: you all are the best. Leaning lemon cake + small kitchen get-together Friday 3pm. No pressure for gifts — if folks want, houseplant or a little succie would be perfect. Card link: https://tinyurl.com/talia-card (feel free to leave a message).

anya: RSVP: yes. Cake choice: lemon.

lee: RSVP: yes. I can do moving-help Saturday AM if you need an extra pair of hands — happy to lug boxes. :muscle:

jenna: RSVP: yes + will bring vegetarian lasagna.

cleo: RSVP: yes, will pick up a ZZ plant en route.

mike: RSVP: yes — bubbles secured. Can we add a gluten-free option?

talia: thank you everyone, really appreciate it. Also pro tip: if you ever need a local moving hack, DM me — learned some tricks today. :)
